reason: The primitive monoclinic cell, volume, and Z=1 are well supported, but exact structure recovery is not. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied; in the trace the submitted rigid-water Pm model had Rwp about 7.20%, whereas materially different P1 fits reached about 5.44% unconstrained and 5.93% with broad chemical restraints. The latter restrained P1 realization was not submitted. The submitted P1 alternative instead came from a stick-intensity optimization without a reported comparable profile score and has an implausibly distorted water geometry (O-H 0.819/1.150 A and H-H 1.850 A). The Pm symmetry and Li/H coordinates were selected mainly through imposed mirror-plane/rigid-water chemistry despite weaker diffraction fit, while the trajectory itself found multiple distinct P1/Pm solutions and acknowledged weak Li/H constraint. A further chemically constrained search comparing rigid-water P1 and Pm models, and retaining the best distinct whole-pattern survivors, could materially improve the candidate set.
